cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned the handbook over like you. Permit on top. It says eight; the handbook says lock at six. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was flattening a curled cover. Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cover flat. So the permit governs public access, and the handbook everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we cancelling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?

reason: Copy page smoothing as selecting precedence and preserve B's actual front/back solution. A covers the mistaken procedure while asking B to choose a rule whose kitchen consequence matters.
